name: Nextcloud
summary: Your own Dropbox/Google Drive: file sync, share links, photos, calendar and more.
gains: Share links, web access and phone photo uploads like Dropbox
Huge app ecosystem (calendar, contacts, office docs)
tradeoffs: Server storage costs extra for large libraries
setupSteps: Rent a server with enough disk (or use a home mini PC)
Install the Nextcloud All-in-One Docker image
Install the desktop and phone apps and log in
